convention: OpenCV camera: +Z forward, +X right, +Y down. World frame is the fixed scene frame, which coincides with the frame-0 camera only up to the frame-0 pose given below. Each entry is T_wc (world-from-camera): `position` is the camera centre in world coordinates and `quaternion` is [qw, qx, qy, qz] of the world-from-camera rotation, i.e. p_world = R * p_camera + position.
